Interview transcript — Ravi Mehta (head archivist, Central Records)
Date: 2025-11-04
Interviewer: Dana Cole
---
Q: How long has the Central Records archive been in operation?
A: The archive has been running since 1987, and we moved the whole collection to the
basement annex in 1995.
---
(00:12:07) "We moved the entire public collection to the basement annex in 1995."
